prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a playful half-grin, cool ash-brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a tin miniature anvil, a tin cube-shaped block, a bronze ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold bracelets. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Nigerian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, deep rich dark-brown skin with a smooth satin glow, a warm natural smile, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, an iron small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (an iron round bell, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a lead barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single rose-gold hair ornament. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal white and black two-tone satin with gold and white two-tone trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
